title: प्रहरी पोशाक खरिद प्रकरण- उपसमितिले कात्तिक महिनाभर प्रमाण जुटाउने, मंसिर १ देखि बयान
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । निर्वाचन प्रहरी, नेपाल प्रहरी र सशस्त्र प्रहरी बलको पोशाक खरिदसम्बन्धी अध्ययन उपसमितिले सम्बन्धित पक्षसँग बयान मंसिर १ देखि १५ गतेसम्मको समय निर्धारण गरेको छ। आज सिंहदरबारमा बसेको अध्ययन उपसमितिको दोस्रो बैठकपछि संयोजक मनिष झाले अध्ययनका लागि आवश्यक तयारी गर्न कात्तिक ३० गतेसम्मको समय छुटाइएको बताए। अध्ययनपछि मंसिर १ देखि १५ गतेसम्म सम्बन्धित पक्ष तथा क्षेत्रगत विज्ञहरूसँग छलफल गरिने बताए। उनले भने, ‘उपसमितिको कार्यावधि दुई महिना अर्थात् मंसिर २० गतेसम्म तोकिएको छ। उपसमिति गठन भएको २० दिन बितिसकेको र बाँकी ४० दिनमध्ये सार्वजनिक बिदाका कारण करिब ३० दिन मात्रै काम गर्न सकिने अवस्था छ। हामीले कार्यावधि र कार्यविधि तोकिसकेका छौँ। आज कार्यसूचीमा काम गर्दै थियौँ। अन्तिम पाँच दिन प्रतिवेदन लेखनका लागि छुट्टाउने भन्ने विषयमा सहमति भएको छ।’ उपसमितिले कात्तिक ३० गतेसम्म पोशाक खरिदसम्बन्धी विषयमा अध्ययन गरी आवश्यक प्रमाण जुटाउने, सम्बन्धित पक्षलाई सोध्नुपर्ने प्रश्न तयार गर्ने र अनुसन्धानको आधार निर्माण गर्ने बताए। मंसिर १६ देखि २० गतेसम्म अन्तिम पाँच दिन प्रतिवेदन लेखनका लागि छुटाइएको बताए। अध्ययन उपसमितिको काम दोषी वा निर्दोष घोषणा गर्नु नभई तथ्य र प्रमाणका आधारमा निष्कर्ष निकालेर सिफारिससहितको प्रतिवेदन तयार गर्नु रहेको बताए। उनले थपे, ‘यो उपसमितिले अध्ययन गर्ने हो। अध्ययनले कहिल्यै निर्णय सुनाउँदैन। प्रतिवेदन लेख्ने, सिफारिस गर्ने र निष्कर्ष सुनाउने हो। निर्णय गर्ने अख्तियारी पूर्ण समितिलाई हुन्छ। अध्ययन पूरा नहुँदै कसैलाई दोषी करार गर्नु उचित हुँदैन। फलानो व्यक्तिले गल्ती गरेकै छ भने त अध्ययन र अनुसन्धान किन चाहियो हामीलाईरु त्यसैले हामी अहिले कुनै पनि ब्ल्याक एन्ड ह्वाइट अवधारणामा पुगेका छैनौँ। हामी अहिले ग्रे जोनमा छौँ र ग्रे जोनमा रहेर नै अध्ययन गर्न चाहन्छौँ।’ Kathmandu. The study subcommittee on the procurement of uniforms for the Election Police, Nepal Police and Armed Police Force has scheduled a time from November 15 to hold a statement with the concerned parties. After the second meeting of the study subcommittee held at Singha Durbar today, coordinator Manish Jha said that time has been allotted until Kartik 30 to make the necessary preparations for the study. He said that after the study, discussions will be held with relevant parties and sectoral experts from November 1 to 3. He said, 'The working period of the subcommittee has been set for two months, i.e. until November 20. 20 days have passed since the subcommittee was formed, and out of the remaining 40 days, only about 30 days can be worked on due to public holidays. We have already set the working period and working procedures. We were working on the agenda today. It has been agreed that the last five days will be set aside for writing the report.' The subcommittee said that it will study the issue related to the purchase of uniforms by Kartik 30, gather necessary evidence, prepare questions to be asked to the concerned parties, and build a basis for investigation. He said that the last five days from November 16 to 20 have been allotted for writing the report. He said that the job of the study subcommittee is not to declare guilty or innocent, but to draw conclusions based on facts and evidence and prepare a report with recommendations. He added, "This subcommittee is to study. The study never makes a decision. It is to write a report, make recommendations, and present conclusions. The full committee has the authority to make decisions. It is not right to convict someone before the study is complete. If a person has already committed a mistake, then why do we need a study and investigation? That is why we have not reached any black and white concept right now. We are currently in a gray zone and we want to study while remaining in the gray zone."

The study subcommittee on the procurement of uniforms for the Election Police, Nepal Police and Armed Police Force has scheduled a time from November 15 to hold a statement with the concerned parties. After the second meeting of the study subcommittee held at Singha Durbar today, coordinator Manish Jha said that time has been allotted until Kartik 30 to make the necessary preparations for the study. He said that after the study, discussions will be held with relevant parties and sectoral experts from November 1 to 3. He said, 'The working period of the subcommittee has been set for two months, i.e. until November 20. 20 days have passed since the subcommittee was formed, and out of the remaining 40 days, only about 30 days can be worked on due to public holidays. We have already set the working period and working procedures. We were working on the agenda today. It has been agreed that the last five days will be set aside for writing the report.' The subcommittee said that it will study the issue related to the purchase of uniforms by Kartik 30, gather necessary evidence, prepare questions to be asked to the concerned parties, and build a basis for investigation. He said that the last five days from November 16 to 20 have been allotted for writing the report. He said that the job of the study subcommittee is not to declare guilty or innocent, but to draw conclusions based on facts and evidence and prepare a report with recommendations. He added, "This subcommittee is to study. The study never makes a decision. It is to write a report, make recommendations, and present conclusions. The full committee has the authority to make decisions. It is not right to convict someone before the study is complete. If a person has already committed a mistake, then why do we need a study and investigation? That is why we have not reached any black and white concept right now. We are currently in a gray zone and we want to study while remaining in the gray zone."
